name: team_outcome
description: Team cycle (roadmap Phase 2): fold the whole run into an honest delivered / not-delivered verdict (the reviewed-branch result). DELIVERED iff every tracking-board item reached 'done' AND the shared branch is green under test_cycle; otherwise a precise mechanism (blocked items, a budget halt leaving work undone, or a branch not green). Counts come from the durable board, so the verdict is an audit, not a tally threaded through the loop.

testCommandsRan.description: The final test cycle's executed commands ([{argv, exitCode, ...}]): a delivered head must show a command naming each frozen acceptance test, or it is unproven against its oracle.

sharedRepo.description: The shared run worktree (the branch a green final-cycle repair is integrated onto).

testsWorktree.description: The final test cycle's own fork worktree (tests_fork); removed here after a green repair is integrated or a red one discarded.

acceptanceTampered.description: Frozen acceptance tests modified after they were frozen (never DELIVERED).

acceptanceUnproven.description: Frozen acceptance tests the final test cycle ran no command for (never DELIVERED).

repairIntegrated.description: True when the final test cycle's repair commit was integrated onto the shared branch (finalHead is then that head).

repairDropped.description: Why a final-cycle repair commit was not integrated (red, or a rebase conflict); never DELIVERED.
